screening_answers.question: Why this role and Prodapt?
screening_answers.answer: The role is about turning foundation models into reliable, production-grade systems, which is the work I do. I have built a multi-agent research system, a hybrid RAG agent with an eval harness and an LLM inference engine, and I want to do that for enterprise teams. It is also on-site in Pune, where I live.

screening_answers.question: What is your experience with LLMs and agentic AI?
screening_answers.answer: multi-agent-research-crew is a planner, parallel researcher, writer and verifier system on a custom Python asyncio DAG using Claude, with retries, timeouts, token budgets and claim-level citation checking. I also built AI agents for internal use at a US-based medical-device company, and an AI receptionist (ai-lead-receptionist) on the Claude API. I hold the Claude Certified Developer and Claude Certified Orchestrator foundations certifications. I have built the orchestration layer myself and have not used LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or CrewAI in production.

screening_answers.question: Describe your RAG and evaluation experience.
screening_answers.answer: site-to-agent turns a website into a grounded chat agent: a crawler, hybrid BM25 and pgvector retrieval fused with RRF, cited answers, SSRF-hardened fetching and an eval harness for answer quality. My evals are custom harnesses and claim-level citation checks; I have not used RAGAS or DeepEval yet.

screening_answers.question: A project you are proud of.
screening_answers.answer: nanoserve (github.com/huss2003/nanoserve), an LLM inference engine built from scratch in Python and PyTorch: paged KV cache, prefix caching, continuous batching with preemption, speculative decoding and an OpenAI-compatible FastAPI streaming API. It reached 3.1x throughput over sequential decoding in my benchmarks, and it taught me how transformer serving behaves under load.

screening_answers.question: Cloud and fine-tuning experience (AWS, Azure, GCP; LoRA/QLoRA)?
screening_answers.answer: I deploy with Docker, GitHub Actions and Vercel, with Supabase and Postgres behind them, and I hold the Google Cloud Generative AI Leader certification. I have not run production workloads on AWS, Azure or GCP, and I have not fine-tuned models; I would pick between prompting, RAG and LoRA based on the task, and I am ready to learn the cloud stack on the job.
